# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can tell if there has been any Summoning spells cast within the area of
effect and within 1 hour per level into the past.
@@ 2
When caster casts any spell from the Animal Summons list, and desires a
specific creature, he will get it 15% of the time. The Summons spell must be
cast within a minute of this one.
@@ 3
Caster can double the range of any active Control or Mastery spell.
@@ 4
This spell will only work between the time a Summoner spell has been cast, and
when the creature arrives. It allows the caster to prevent the creature from
arriving if it fails a RR versus the caster’s level. Will only work on
creatures that are not higher level than the caster. The target of this spell
can be either the summoner or the creature (if it is visible and still
forming).
@@ 5
Caster’s next summoned creature (arriving within one minute of this spell)
will serve the caster for twice as long as normal.
@@ 6
As Specify Creature I, except the chance is 30%.
@@ 7
The caster’s next summoned creature will arrive at the end of the round that
he casts the Summoning spell (within one minute of this spell).
@@ 8
Caster can triple the range of any active Control or Mastery spell.
@@ 10
While this spell is active, all Summoning spells become Instantaneous, and
each controlled creature only requires 25% activity to control.
@@ 11
Caster’s next summons spell from the Planar Summons spell list has all rolls
for how powerful of an entity is summoned modified by +10.
@@ 13
As Servitude II, except the creature will serve for three times as long as
normal.
@@ 14
The next creature summoned by the caster will serve the caster for the
duration of this spell.
@@ 15
This spell is cast before a Summoning spell (that cannot be higher than 10th
level) is cast. It will delay the arrival of the summoned creatures up to 1
day per level of the caster or until triggered by one of the following
(decided at the time of casting): specified movements, touch, or a specific
action. The caster may specify (at the time of casting) a single task for the
creature(s) to perform when it (they) arrive.
@@ 16
Caster can quadruple the range of any active Control or Mastery spell.
@@ 17
As Potent Summons, except the modifier is +20.
@@ 18
As Legion, except controlled creature only requires 10% activity to control.
@@ 20
As Specify Creature I, except the chance is 70%.
@@ 25
Caster can quintuple the range of any active Control or Mastery spell.
@@ 30
As Waiting Summons. except it can be cast with any level Summons spell.
@@ 50
Caster gains permanent control of the next creature he summons and controls.
This creature will receive a RR against this spell. If the creature fails the
RR, it is permanently bound to the caster’s plane, and is placed under the
control of the caster and will unfailingly obey him. The caster can have as
many of these creatures under his control as he wishes.
